summary: Join us as a DevOps Engineer at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape and drive innovation and excellence.
responsibilities: Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use.
required_skills: Hands-on experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment using tools like Gradle, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines using GITLAB, Jenkins, Chef, Ansible etc.
Solid understanding of Service First, release management, patching, and vulnerability management is essential.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools like ELK, ESaaS, AppDynamics.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with Kafka/ActiveMQ or other message brokers for event-driven communication
Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform etc.
Incident and Problem Management skills to Monitor and resolve issues swiftly to minimize downtime.
